userText: Draft a send_message for dispute PP-R-CLK-10200002. First read the dispute with get_dispute_detail and the demo store order with get_store_order. Use the store order id from the checklist item "order" (its source id looks like order:JH-1042, so the order id is JH-1042, not the dispute id). Then call draft_response with action "send_message", the checklist items exactly as get_dispute_detail returned them (id, present, source_id) and your text. Write the text only from facts in those records. The only dollar amounts you may use are the disputed amount and the offer amount the tools returned; the server rejects any other amount. If draft_response returns an error, fix the text and call it again. Nothing is sent: the seller reviews and approves the card.

For reference, the listing describes it as a hand glazed stoneware shade, 7 in diameter, and notes that small imperfections are part of the glaze. The listing included 2 photos. UPS tracking 1Z999AA10123456784 shows the package was delivered on 2026-11-02. To help us look into the chip on the rim and the size, could you please send clear photos of the shade, including the rim, with something next to it for scale? Once we have them, we will review and work with you on a resolution.
